1 For VSC LTE: Subject Tender is floated on Limited Tender (LT) basis and V endors eligible to participate have been short-listed and approved by Co mpetent Authority as per Works & Procurement Policy of NTPC. Email will be sent to the aforesaid shortlisted vendors at their e-mail IDs registered with NTPC against the shortlisted vendors’ vendor codes for participation in the subject tender on GeM Portal. Only those bidders who have receive d the aforesaid invitation mail from NTPC should participate in the subjec t tender. In case any vendor in receipt of the said mail has multiple vendor codes in NTPC linked to th at mail ID, it would be responsibility of the vendor to obtain a confirmatio n, by using the representation window in GeM, regarding the vendor who is eligible to bid against the tender. Any bid received from non-eligible v endor linked to that mail ID will be rejected. Any Other Bidder(s) who is not shortlisted/approved by Competent Autho rity for this Bid and have not received email in this regard, shall not be co nsidered and bids of such bidder(s) shall be summarily rejected during Te chnical Evaluation. Authorized Dealers/ Channel Partners of those "manufacturers" who have received the aforesaid invitation mail from NTPC can also participate in th is tender in lieu of the OEM. However, such dealers/ channel partners sha ll have to submit a Bid-Specific Authorization Certificate from the manufa cturer along with their bids. Only a single authorisation per OEM shall be admissible. GeM Contract shall be issued in the name of the vendor who submits offer in GeM. Authorisation issued by any bidder who is not a ma nufacturer will not be considered valid. However, if a shortlisted manufac turer authorises multiple dealers/ channel partners to submit bids, all suc h bids shall be rejected.

2 Nil deviation clause for all schedules: Compliance to ALL provisions of the bidding document (Nil Deviation bid) is mandatory which is to be accepted through the “Seller undertaking” d uring submission of offer by the seller in GeM. Through their acceptance, the seller undertakes the following: “1. With reference to our bid submitted against the tender, we hereby co nfirm that we comply with all terms, conditions and specifications of the Bidding Documents read in conjunction with Amendment(s) / Clarification (s) / Addenda/Errata (if any) issued by the Employer prior to opening of T echno-Commercial Bids and the same has been taken into consideration while making our Techno-Commercial Bid & Price Bid and we declare that we have not taken any deviation in this regard. 2. We understand that in case the Products and/or Services offered do no t meet the technical requirements, then our bid shall be rejected as Tech nically non-responsive. We also confirm that in case we refuse to withdraw additional conditions/ deviation s/variations/exception, implicit or explicit, found anywhere in th e techno-commercial bid, our bid shall be rejected as Technically non-res ponsive. We further confirm that if any deviation/variation in any form is found in our Price Bid, the EMD shall be forfeited”. 3 If any seller/bidder has any clarification against technical specification or otherwise on any aspect of this bid, they can raise their representation a gainst the same by using the Representation Window provided in the bid details field in Seller dashboard after logging in as a seller within the time period after bid publication as allowed by GeM. Clarification asked throug h any means other than above, may not be considered by NTPC.

4 Bidder may quote as per "Technical Specification" and/ or spec sheet atta ched for each line item/ schedule. In case of any contradiction between C ategory/ BOQ Item description and "Technical Specification" of the item(s ) attached in the tender, TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION OF THAT ITEM SHOU LD BE CONSIDERED FOR THE SUBMISSION OF OFFER AND SAME SHALL B E CONSIDERED FOR EVALUATION PURPOSE AT OUR END. The details men tioned in the detailed Technical specification shall be considered final for the offer/ bid/ technical evaluation. Bidder has to quote make and model in GeM as per option available in Ge M during submission of offer after meeting all the technical specification of tender. After opening of bids, any change in vendor's quoted make or model in their bid cannot be done and any such request will be rejected. I n the event of an order, vendor’s quoted make and model in their bid will also get automatically populated in the GEM Purchase order. Also, MSE & MII benefits will be given exclusively based on documents submitted in re ference to the "quoted make and model" submitted in the GeM bid. 5 Guarantee/Warranty: 12 months from the date of use/commissioning or 1 8 months from the date of supply, whichever is earlier. (The Guarantee/ Warranty Terms and Conditions shall be applicable to the material suppli ed against the PO. No separate Guarantee/ Warranty Certificate is requir ed to be submitted by the Supplier along with the material. The Guarante e / Warranty terms and condition shall be binding on the supplier). If any higher Guarantee/warranty mentioned in the technical specification the s ame shall be applicable. 6 Common IP Addresses: - Bidders may please note that GeM is capturing a nd presenting to the buyer the IP addresses used by the Buyer and the Bi dder(s) /Seller(s). The received bids having matching/common IP addr ess with either Bidder(s)/Seller(s) or Buyer, shall be outrightly rejec ted & shall not be considered for further evaluation. 7 During techno-commercial evaluation of offer, clarification/ reply to the q ueries (if asked by NTPC) given by bidder will be considered an integral p art of the GeM purchase order and the vendor will be liable to execute th e PO also in accordance with the same. Furthermore, in the event subseq uent clarification(s)/query(ies) are sought and bidder fails to respond or r esponds with incorrect / inadequate or non-compliant information, the bi d will be liable to be rejected. Subsequent representation(s) may not be accepted in such cases. 8 All post award communication/ grievance will be addressed to consignee at email id: storeincharge-barauni@ntpc.co.in. In case of non-resolution o f the issue, matter can be escalated along with previous correspondence( s) to email id:- vendor_grievance_cpg2@ntpc.co.in.

9 Payment terms: As per GeM bid 10 Make in India (MII): Not applicable 11 CONFLICT OF INTEREST: A bidder shall not have conflict of interest with other bidders. Such confli ct of interest can lead to anti- competitive practices to the detriment of E mployer’s interests. A bidder may be considered to have a conflict of inte rest with one or more parties in this bidding process, if: a) they directly or indirectly control, or are controlled by or are under co mmon control of another entity; or b) they have the same legal representative/agent for purposes of their bi ds; or c) they have relationship with each other, directly or through common thi rd party(ies), that puts them in a position to have access to information a bout or influence on the bid of another Bidder; or d) Bidder and/or any of its allied entity(ies), which directly or indirectly co ntrol(s) or is(are) controlled by or is(are) under common control of anothe r entity, has(ve) participated as a consultant in the preparation of the des ign or technical specifications of the contract that is the subject of the te nder; or e) Bidder participates in more than one bid in this bidding process. f) In cases of agents quoting on behalf of their principal manufacturers/se rvice providers, one agent cannot represent two manufacturers/service p roviders or quote on their behalf in a particular tender enquiry. One man ufacturer/service provider can also authorize only one agent. There can b e only one bid from the following: i) The principal manufacturer/service provider directly or through one Ind ian agent on his behalf; and ii) Indian/foreign agent on behalf of only one principal. For the purposes of this clause the term ‘control’ shall have the following meaning: “Control” shall include the right to appoint majority of the directors or to control the management or policy decisions exercisable by a person or p ersons acting individually or in concert, directly or indirectly, including by virtue of their shareholding or management rights or shareholders’ agree ments or voting agreements or in any other manner. Vendor has to submit CONFLICT OF INTEREST declaration in bid during su bmission offer as detail as “We confirm that we have read and understoo d the Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Clause regarding “Conflict of Interest ” and our bid is in compliance to this clause. In case it is established that we have provided any false information in pursuance of the aforesaid Cla use, while competing for this contract, then our bid shall be rejected and

bid security shall be forfeited. We also understand that in case we becom e successful bidder, if it is established that we have not complied with ter ms of aforesaid Clause, during execution of contract, this would be consi dered as fraudulent practice as mentioned in para 5.1 (j) of “Policy for D ebarment from Business Dealings” and shall be dealt accordingly.” Note: Policy for Debarment from Business Dealings available at "https://n tpc.co.in/sites/default/files/policy- documents/Policy_for_Debarment_from _Business_Dealings.pdf". CONFLICT OF INTEREST DECLARATION FORM ……………………………………. PACKAGE FOR …………………………………… ……………………………. PROJECT BIDDING DOCUMENT NO. ………………… ………………….. (Compliance to “Conflict of Interest” provisions) We confirm that we have read and understood the ITB* Clause regarding “Conflict of Interest” and our bid is in compliance to this clause. In case it is established that we have provided any false information in p ursuance of the aforesaid ITB* Clause, while competing for this contract, then our bid shall be rejected and bid security shall be forfeited. We also understand that in case we become successful bidder, if it is est ablished that we have not complied with terms of aforesaid ITB Clause, d uring execution of contract, this would be considered as fraudulent practi ce as mentioned in para 5.1 (j) of “Policy for Debarment from Business D ealings” and shall be dealt accordingly. 12 Risk purchase- In the event of Suppliers failure to supply the material of a cceptable quality in scheduled delivery period, NTPC reserves the right to procure the materials from any other source at the Suppliers risk and cos t and the difference in cost shall be borne by the Supplier. Further, NTPC shall retain the right of forfeiture of CPG/ PBG and or any other action as deemed fit. 13 Pre-Dispatch Inspection (PDI): PDI by NTPC is not envisaged. Vendor, alon gwith material, shall submit test certificate / internal inspection reports as per attached STC.

14 EMD Not applicable. 15 Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) Detail Not APPLICABLE 16 MSME benefit (purchase preference) is to be given as per following condi tions: In case of procurement of goods/ services, preferences to MSEs whose qu oted prices are within L1 (non-MSEs) +15% range (subject to matching of L1 price) will be given in the following order: a) SC-ST Women MSEs b) SC-ST other than Women MSEs c) Women MSEs d) Other MSEs The MSE order quantity will be as per following: i. Where the requirement is Not-Splitable: 100% of contract quantity will be awarded to MSEs. ii. Where the requirement is Splitable: 25% of contract quantity will be a warded to MSEs. In case of more than one MSEs (for the same category) are within range of L1+15 % price, then 25% of tendered quantity will be divided equally amongst them. . 5.
